name: MOG Digitech Holdings Limited
summary: MOG Digitech Holdings Limited is an investment holding company, incorporated in 2019 and headquartered in Nanchang, that provides digital payment, e-commerce and financing services in China and Malaysia. Its businesses include digital payments, optical product retail and franchise management, e-commerce and receivables financing. It sells lenses, frames and eyewear and runs optometrist services. It was MOG Holdings Limited until April 2023.
